newsitem.title: CANADA: DBRS says puts Avenor debt under review.
newsitem.headline: DBRS says puts Avenor debt under review.

text.p: Dominion Bond Rating Service said on Wednesday that it is placing its debt ratings for Avenor Inc under review with negative implications.
The agency's decision followed Avenor's earlier announcement that it intends to acquire Repap Enterprises Inc in a deal worth C$3.3 billion.
Avenor's senior debentures are currently rated at BB (high), while the company's convertible subordinated debentures carry a B (high) rating.
Both ratings carry positive trends, DBRS said in a statement.

"Given the price volatility shown by most forest product prices, as well as the ageing of the current North American business cycle, the financial profile of the merged company is aggressive," DBRS said.
